name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding dumbbells beside the thighs, palms forward.
Keep upper arms near the ribs and curl the weights toward the shoulders.
Lower until the elbows are nearly straight.
cues: Keep wrists in line with forearms.
mistakes: Swinging the weights with the hips.
Bending wrists back at the top.
breathing: Exhale as you curl; inhale as you lower.
